title: Artifact body
description: The envelope a structured Artifact body shares (D13, #5 decision 8): ordered blocks, each with the Locators it rests on. The content Blob of an Artifact whose type has a body schema holds it as JSON, its bytes canonical_json(body) so the same body is the same Blob, and that schema narrows it (extraction: artifact/extraction); later types extend it by adding members. The Hub writes it; open: clients ignore members they do not know.

v.description: Version of the body shape; this contract defines 1, and a newer Hub may send a higher one.

blocks.description: In order: a block's position is its ordinal, from 0.

id.description: Derived by the Hub, the same for the same input, and unique within the body; the body schema says how (extraction: rule block_id, which also makes it unique; #8 adds the check for its types). An LLM cites a block only by this id, and the Hub turns the id into the block's refs (D13).

block_type.description: Known types are the examples; a newer Hub may send others, which a client shows by their text. heading: a heading, payload heading_payload. paragraph: running text. page: one page of a PDF, its ref that page; without text when the page has no text layer (extraction warning no_text_layer). table: a table inside a document, its text the rows joined by a line feed and each row's cells by a tab, a tab or line break inside a cell written as a space, a merged cell written once at its top-left cell; a long table is split between rows into several blocks; no payload. table_row: one row of a sheet or of a delimited file, its text the row's cells joined by a tab and its ref the row's cells as one sheet_range; payload table_row_payload. table_header: a row that heads the columns below it, otherwise as table_row, without a payload. notes: the speaker notes of a slide, its ref that slide.

text.description: The block's text; absent for a block that has none.

payload.description: Structured content whose shape the block_type names: heading and table_row define one (payload_of_type). Open: a client ignores members it does not know, and the payload of a block_type it does not know.

refs.description: Where in the originals the block rests; empty for a block with no evidence, which a client shows as unsupported.

payload_of_type.description: Checks the payload of a block_type that defines one, when the block has a payload; a block_type without a payload shape keeps any object.

level.description: The heading's depth in the document's outline, from 1 for the outermost.

formulas.description: The formulas of the row's cells that have one, keyed by the cell in A1 notation (one cell of the block's row, uppercase, without $); each is the formula text as the workbook stores it, without the leading =. The text holds the cell's cached value. Absent when no cell of the row has a formula.
